Here's how to turn your illustration into a satisfying speedpaint video.
Step one. Tap Replace and upload your illustration.
Finished art with clean outlines works best.
Step two. Pencil gives soft, sketchy strokes, the classic speedpaint look.
Show the drawing pencil, and keep the colour on.
Step three. For the Instagram feed, pick one by one Square, in Full HD.
Step four. Press play to preview it.
Tap View original to compare it with your artwork.
Step five. Tap Export, then download your MP4.
Your art, speedpainted. Open the studio and make your first one.
